issues.description: Duplicate imports in auth/page.tsx — useEffect and useState are imported twice from 'react', causing a compile error that breaks Fast Refresh and triggers RSC fetch failures
issues.root_cause: Line 2 imports `{ useEffect, useState }` from 'react', and line 5 also imports `{ FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState }` from 'react'. Two separate import statements for the same module with overlapping named exports causes the 'defined multiple times' SWC error.

issues.description: React hydration mismatch on step-1 page causing entire root to switch to client rendering
issues.root_cause: Text content rendered on server does not match client-side render, likely due to dynamic/random values (e.g. particle positions, timestamps, Math.random()) computed at render time without being wrapped in a client-only block or suppressing hydration warnings.

fixes.new_str:
import { Cormorant_Garamond, Manrope } from "next/font/google";
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import of useEffect and useState. Consolidate into the single import on line 5 that already includes FormEvent and useMemo.
